guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice_cpu rose from 0.29 to 7.69 (+2593%, z=+305), with latency-90 up 854% and sockets tripling; no other service shows a comparable shift (checkoutservice latency-90 only +5.6%). Confidence is held to medium because the worst traces never pass through emailservice (error spans are in frontendservice), and the logs have no warning/error lines to corroborate, so the link between the emailservice CPU anomaly and the user-facing alert is not directly confirmed.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate the emailservice CPU spike (check for a runaway process or load), then restart or scale out emailservice replicas and apply CPU limits; also verify why frontendservice traces are erroring, since they do not touch emailservice.
